items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: Letter is dated Thursday, 19.11.2026. The period is counted ab dem Datum dieses Briefes; applying the default civil-law rule (section 187(1) BGB) for a period beginning with a stated event/date, that date itself is not counted and counting starts the next day. Counting unit is Arbeitstage defined by the letter as Monday to Friday, with public holidays excluded (none fall in this window for NW). Day 1 = Fri 20.11.2026; Day 2 = Mon 23.11.2026; Day 3 = Tue 24.11.2026; Day 4 = Wed 25.11.2026; Day 5 = Thu 26.11.2026; Day 6 = Fri 27.11.2026; Day 7 = Mon 30.11.2026; Day 8 = Tue 01.12.2026; Day 9 = Wed 02.12.2026; Day 10 = Thu 03.12.2026; Day 11 = Fri 04.12.2026; Day 12 = Mon 07.12.2026 (weekends 21 to 22 Nov, 28 to 29 Nov, 05 to 06 Dec skipped as non-working days; no public holidays in NW fall in this range). Day 12 already lands on a working Monday so no further shift is needed.

warnings: The letter states that without a reply by the deadline the place will be given to the next family on the waiting list, so a timely response before 2026-12-07 is important; the exact counting of Arbeitstage ab dem Datum dieses Briefes is the sender's own informal definition rather than a statutory term, so confirming the exact deadline directly with the Kita is advisable.
